notes.title: PixelJunk Shooter Ultimate Announcement
notes.content:
Hey folks,

We know some of you have been asking for some time about Shooter 2 or Shooter Ultimate, well today we are proud to announce, in our continued collaboration with Kyoto based Q-Games, that PixelJunk Shooter Ultimate will launch on Steam and Windows PC TODAY!

So what is PixelJunk Shooter Ultimate?
We’ve combined Shooter 1 and 2 to make a seamless story mode featuring all of the levels from the two games. We’ve also changed up the Graphics and UI of both games, we’ve completely overhauled them to create the new ‘Ultimate’ art style. Among a host of changes and improvements that make, what we believe, this to be the best edition of the game ever for Steam

In addition to all of that we've done in creating the ultimate edition, our Steam edition gets a number of enhancements! :
 

    Carry your save file from PixelJunk Shooter (Steam) into Shooter Ultimate. (Meaning those with Save Data can jump straight into the PixelJunk Shooter 2 levels.)
    Switch between the new ‘Ultimate’ art style and the ‘Classic’ art style at any time.
    Keyboard & Mouse support with full Key Rebinding available.
    Steam Achievements, Leaderboards and Trading Cards.
    Rebalanced Online Battle mode which makes it much quicker to progress through the ranks and unlock new items.
    A new Photo Mode which allows players to instantly pause the game and remove the HUD for beautiful screenshots.


Coupons?
As a reward for fans of the series, all owners of PixelJunk Shooter will receive a 20% off coupon, all owners of any PixelJunk Series title will receive an additional 5% off per game. This could also include the already 10% off sale price for an up to max of 45% off PixelJunk Shooter Ultimate. These coupons will be active through Steam, as well as select other retailers and they will expire November 3rd at 9am PST.

----------

We look forward to you guys trying it out and giving us feedback, for more information on PixelJunk Shooter Ultimate Click HERE.

D.Arquette
Community Manager and QA Tester @ Double Eleven

notes.title: Patch 1.01 is live!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

After reading a lot of feedback on these discussion boards, we have addressed the following issues in patch 1.01.

1.	The game should no longer crash when booting the game without a sound card.
2.	An issue with collisions has been resolved on the OSX version of the game whereby liquids would not behave correctly.
3.	Additional support for a greater variance of controllers.
4.	Actions can now be bound to up to two buttons on a controller. 
5.	Various minor bug fixes.

We are still addressing some other issues that have been brought up, and will release an update with these fixes as soon as we can.

Thank you so much for your patience and feedback, and as always, we will endeavour to continue making the PixelJunk Shooter experience better going forward.

Kindest Regards,
Rich
